data.content_ref: inline:The target replaces the required absolute guarantee with a conditional BFT guarantee that depends on extraneous assumptions—independent storage nodes and an honest supermajority—which are not stated in the problem and are not guaranteed to hold. BFT consensus only ensures safety if fewer than one-third of witnesses are faulty, so the protocol is not 'guaranteed never' to displace evidence; it is merely guaranteed not to under specific external conditions. Furthermore, the target entirely ignores the given determinism of the workspace, which is the central property that should enable safe reclamation, making the protocol over-engineered and substantively misaligned with the problem.
